Restyle and refocus the Repro Suite hub. Our mentors asked us to focus on two main products: Paper Explainer (learn a paper) and Paper Repro Agent (check a paper). The other apps become supporting tools. Keep the existing screenshots in public/shots/ and the EN / 中文 switch.

DESIGN SYSTEM (exactly the same as https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/index.html, so every Repro Suite app looks like one product; replace the current serif headings and palette)
- Light theme first, dark on a toggle button (☾ / ☀), remembered in localStorage key "repro.theme2".
- Light: background #FBFBFD, cards #FFFFFF, soft fill #F3F3F6, text #1D1D1F, secondary text #5C5C66, borders #E4E4EA, accent #2B59FF, accent tint #ECF0FF. Dark: background #0B0B0E, cards #151519, soft #1C1C22, text #F4F4F6, secondary #ADADB8, borders #2A2A31, accent #7B96FF, accent tint #1B2146.
- Font Inter (Google Fonts) with Noto Sans SC for Chinese; JetBrains Mono for numbers. Headlines weight 800, letter-spacing -0.035em. Cards radius 16px, 1px border, soft shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.06). Pill buttons (radius 999px), primary = accent. Generous white space like apple.com and tally.so. One accent colour only.

LAYOUT: left sidebar 248px (sticky, full height; on screens under 900px a drawer opened from a ☰ button in a slim top bar). Top of the sidebar: black rounded square logo with a white "R", "Repro Suite", grey line "Learn a paper. Then check it."
Sidebar groups: "Main products": Paper Explainer https://paperexplainer-aiid.pub.atoms.world , Paper Repro Agent https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/index.html . "Supporting tools": Repro Lite https://reprolite-aiid.pub.atoms.world , Reading Companion https://readingcompanion-aiid.pub.atoms.world , IndexBoard https://indexboard-aiid.pub.atoms.world/b/5dhum9j5h0 , Repro Desk https://reprodesk-aiid.pub.atoms.world . "Research": Benchmark https://paperrepro-aiid.atoms.world/repro/bench.html . Each opens in a new tab with a small ↗. Bottom: theme and language buttons.

PAGE (main column max 1080px)
1. Hero: eyebrow "Repro Suite" in accent. H1 "Learn a paper. Then check it." Sub: "Two tools for AI research papers: a short narrated video that explains the paper, and an agent that re-runs the experiment and tells you whether the number holds." Buttons: "Explain a paper" (primary → Paper Explainer) and "Check a paper" (secondary → Paper Repro Agent).
2. Two large product cards side by side (stack on phone), equal size, each with its screenshot on top (16:10, rounded) or for Paper Explainer a real video:
   - "Learn · Paper Explainer": a video element (controls, preload metadata, src + "#t=2") using the newest MP4 from GET https://vzvyghmtsakixlhzzuol.supabase.co/functions/v1/explainer-render?recent=1 (field videos.en of the first item). Text: "Paste an arXiv link and get a 40 second video in English and 中文. Every quote and number on screen is checked against the paper." A live line: "<n> videos made" where n is the length of that list. Button "Make a video".
   - "Check · Paper Repro Agent": its screenshot. Text: "The agent reads the paper, fixes a tolerance before any code runs, writes and runs the code, re-runs it from scratch and gives a verdict." Facts row: 6 models, 32 papers, 281 runs, best Repro Index 89.2. Button "Watch a reproduction".
3. "How they fit together": one simple horizontal diagram: Paper → Explainer (understand it) → Repro Agent (check it) → Benchmark (compare models). Thin lines and numbered circles, no emoji.
4. "Supporting tools": a 4-column grid of smaller cards (2 on tablet, 1 on phone) with the existing screenshots: Repro Lite, Reading Companion, IndexBoard, Repro Desk, each one sentence and an Open link.
5. Footer: Group 1, Tsinghua SIGS AIID capstone, partners DeepWisdom and StepFun; links to all apps.
Remove the old "Shared, safe back end" and "Example result" sections and any serif fonts. English and Chinese for every new text. Check the page in both themes and that 390px has no horizontal scroll.
I'll check the Paper Explainer video feed first, since the main product card depends on its data.
The video feed returns data and allows cross-origin requests, so I'm rewriting the theme, content and page in your new design system and removing the old browser-frame component.
The video loads, but my live-count check came back empty. It probably matched a different element on the page, so I'll re-check the "videos made" line with a precise selector.
The live count works (8 videos, in both languages), so I'll update the project notes and run the visual check.
The visual check reported empty screenshot areas, so I'll confirm in a real browser that every screenshot loads, in both themes, before reporting.

I've rebuilt the Repro Suite hub around Paper Explainer and Paper Repro Agent. It now uses the same design as the Paper Repro Agent page, and the existing screenshots and EN / 中文 switch are kept. Lint and the build pass. I checked it in a real browser at desktop size and at 390px, in both themes and both languages: no horizontal scroll at 390px, and the sidebar is 248px. Every screenshot and the video load. An automated visual check reported a few blank screenshot areas, but those images all loaded in the browser checks.

- **Design:**
  - Light theme by default, with a ☾ / ☀ button for dark, remembered under "repro.theme2".
  - Your exact colours, Inter with Noto Sans SC for Chinese, and JetBrains Mono for numbers.
  - Bold headlines, 16px cards with a soft shadow, pill buttons and one blue accent.
  - All serif fonts are gone.
- **Sidebar:** the R logo, name and tagline at the top, then your three link groups with ↗, and the theme and language buttons at the bottom. Under 900px it becomes a slim top bar with a ☰ menu.
- **Page:**
  - The hero has your headline and both buttons.
  - The two product cards sit side by side and stack on phones.
  - "How they fit together" shows Paper → Explainer → Repro Agent → Benchmark with numbered circles.
  - Below that are the four supporting tools, then the footer with your team, partners and links to all seven apps.
  - The "Shared, safe back end" and "Example result" sections are removed.
- **Live video:** the Paper Explainer card plays the newest video from your feed, starting at 2 seconds. Right now that's the Retrieval-Augmented Generation video, and the card reads "8 videos made". If the feed can't be reached, the card shows the Paper Explainer screenshot and a short note instead.

Things to check:
- **Video count:** the count is the number of items the feed returns. If that feed only lists recent videos, it may be lower than your real total.
- **Chinese video:** the card plays the English video in both languages, as you specified. The feed also has a Chinese version, so I can switch to it when the page is in 中文 if you'd like.
- **Card text:** I shortened the Reading Companion, IndexBoard and Repro Desk descriptions to one sentence each, as you asked. Please make sure they still say what you want.
- **Wording I wrote:** you didn't supply the line under each section heading or the Chinese versions of your new text, so I wrote them. Please check them too.

You can review it in App Viewer, then click Publish to update the live site.

# Project Summary
Repro Suite is a bilingual product hub for discovering and opening six tools for research reproducibility and paper communication. It presents tool cards with screenshots, explains the reproduction workflow, and highlights an example result. The static site also includes a blog, language and theme controls, and links to each tool. It does not require a database or API keys.

# Project Module Description
- **Hub page:** Introduces the suite with a browser-frame hero, product metrics, six tool cards, a five-step reproduction workflow, an example result, and shared-backend information.
- **Tool directory:** Provides bilingual descriptions, audience labels, screenshots, and Open links for:
  - **Paper Repro Agent:** Reproduces a paper’s headline result through tolerance setting, code execution, a clean rerun, and an audit.
  - **Repro Lite:** Quickly checks a single claim using Python in the browser.
  - **Reading Companion:** Helps users read papers, save quoted notes, cite claims, and identify what could not be verified.
  - **IndexBoard:** Builds leaderboards from results or descriptions, including intervals and ties.
  - **Repro Desk:** Offers a human-checked reproduction request as a free pilot.
  - **Paper Explainer:** Turns a paper into a short cinematic explainer video. The first 20 seconds are free, and users can make a preview of their own paper. Intended for authors promoting a new paper and readers seeking a quick overview. Links to [Paper Explainer](https://paperexplainer-aiid.pub.atoms.world).
- **Screenshot assets:** Locally hosted WebP screenshots illustrate the tools; the hero uses overlapping browser frames for depth.
- **Language and theme controls:** English/Chinese and light/dark toggles; preferences persist between visits.
- **Blog:** Blog index and article pages with Markdown rendering and prerendering support.
- **Shared UI:** Reusable interface components and hooks for navigation, forms, dialogs, notifications, and responsive layouts.

# Directory Tree
```text
app/frontend/
├── .mgx/config.yaml                 # Project tooling configuration
├── DESIGN.md                        # Design guidance
├── README.md                        # Frontend setup notes
├── components.json                  # UI component configuration
├── eslint.config.js                 # ESLint configuration
├── index.html                       # HTML entry template
├── package.json                     # Dependencies and npm scripts
├── playwright.config.ts             # Playwright configuration
├── plugins/                         # Development safeguards and tests
├── postcss.config.js                # PostCSS configuration
├── prerender/                       # Blog prerendering and sitemap utilities
├── public/
│   ├── shots/                       # Locally hosted product screenshots (WebP)
│   │   └── paperexplainer.webp      # Paper Explainer home-page screenshot
│   ├── favicon*                     # Site icons
│   └── robots.txt                   # Crawler instructions
├── scripts/
│   └── capture_shots.py             # Captures and optimizes product screenshots
├── site.config.json                 # Site configuration
├── src/
│   ├── App.tsx                      # App root and route setup
│   ├── App.css                      # App-level styles
│   ├── blog-routes.tsx              # Blog route definitions
│   ├── index.css                    # Global styles and theme tokens
│   ├── main.tsx                     # React entry point
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── blog/                    # Blog article layout and Markdown renderer
│   │   ├── site/
│   │   │   └── BrowserFrame.tsx     # Reusable browser screenshot frame
│   │   └── ui/                      # Reusable interface components
│   ├── hooks/                       # Mobile viewport and toast hooks
│   ├── lib/
│   │   ├── api.ts                   # API utilities
│   │   ├── blog.ts                  # Blog data helpers
│   │   ├── config.ts                # Configuration helpers
│   │   ├── content.ts               # Static tool content and translations
│   │   └── utils.ts                 # Shared utilities
│   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── AuthCallback.tsx         # Authentication callback page
│   │   ├── AuthError.tsx            # Authentication error page
│   │   ├── Index.tsx                # Product hub and tool directory
│   │   └── blog/                    # Blog index and post pages
│   └── vite-env.d.ts                # Vite type declarations
├── tailwind.config.ts               # Tailwind CSS configuration
├── template_config.json             # Template settings
├── tsconfig*.json                   # TypeScript configurations
└── vite.config.ts                   # Vite configuration
```

# File Description Inventory
- `src/pages/Index.tsx`: Hub hero, metrics, six tool cards, process steps, example result, backend information, and footer.
- `src/lib/content.ts`: Bilingual tool descriptions, audience labels, and hub copy.
- `src/components/site/BrowserFrame.tsx`: Shared browser-style frame used to display product screenshots.
- `public/shots/`: Optimized WebP product screenshots, including `paperexplainer.webp`.
- `scripts/capture_shots.py`: Captures product pages and saves optimized screenshots.
- `src/App.tsx`, `src/main.tsx`: Application routing and entry point.
- `src/index.css`, `src/App.css`: Global design tokens and application styles.
- `src/pages/blog/`, `src/components/blog/`, `src/blog-routes.tsx`: Blog pages, article rendering, and routes.
- `prerender/`: Blog prerendering, sitemap generation, and helpers.
- `src/components/ui/`, `src/hooks/`, `src/lib/`: Shared UI, hooks, content, configuration, blog, API, and utility helpers.
- `plugins/` and root configuration files: Development safeguards, tests, and build, lint, styling, type-checking, and browser-test configuration.

# Technology Stack
- React and TypeScript
- Vite
- Tailwind CSS and PostCSS
- Lucide icons
- WebP product screenshots
- Playwright and ESLint
- Python Playwright and Pillow for screenshot capture
- Static site content; no database or API keys required

# Usage
From the frontend directory, install dependencies and start the development server:
```bash
cd app/frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

Run lint and build checks:
```bash
npm run lint
npm run build
```

To refresh screenshots, use `scripts/capture_shots.py`. Screenshot capture requires Python Playwright and Pillow.
